To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
The Gamow-Teller strength distribution in nuclei is sensitive to the nuclear density and the deformation of the bags of quarks in a nucleus.
the Gamow-Teller strength in nuclei with deforming bags of quarks is reduced by a factor of 2.5 compared to the case with spherical bags.
the total Gamow-Teller strength in the low energy sector is reduced by 10 to 30 percent, depending on the nucleus, and the strength in the Delta sector is enhanced by a factor of 2 to 4.

the effects of deformation and the nuclear medium on the Gamow-Teller strength distribution.
